scoring.primary: Per-case verified introduced domain defects, occurrences and distinct mechanisms; all three paired results retained. Money primary covers representation/conversion/rounding/missing-data paths; CAD primary covers geometry/artifact/acceptance defects. Report other findings separately.
scoring.verification: Collect all outputs, remove arm labels and procedure references, freeze anonymized claims, then independently reproduce against base and head before unsealing the arm mapping. Two fresh verification passes, one per case. Preserve unresolved and unsupported claims.
scoring.known_findings: Documented first-generation fit failure and previously verified mechanisms may be rediscovered but are not historically new discoveries. Verify overlap with earlier reports after blind adjudication.
scoring.false_findings: Unsupported claims and invalid blockers counted separately; no exhaustive ground truth, so no total recall or overall accuracy claim. Clean seeded controls and routing are deterministic acceptance only.
scoring.missing_evidence: Slicer and physical claims require actual observations. No pending check may become pass from digital evidence.
scoring.failure: Every launched slot stays in the denominator. Preserve timeouts, source mutations, budget/format failures and interruptions; never silently replace. Stop to inspect repeated infrastructure failure.
scoring.benefit: Exploratory case-specific comparison only; ties and regressions preserved. No automatic activation or broad benefit qualification.
